cim: Survey: Patient comfort with AI varies by level of provider involvement
cim_eredeti: Survey: Patient comfort with AI varies by level of provider involvement
szoveg_eredeti: A Gallup survey published Nov. 9 on patient comfort with artificial intelligence in care found that 56% of U.S. adults who visited a primary care provider in the past year are comfortable with AI making diagnosis or treatment decisions, as long as they can be changed or overridden by their provider. The survey found that 38% of patients are comfortable when AI assists and their provider makes the decision. Results showed that 9% of patients are comfortable with AI making treatment decisions without provider review.

prioritas.cim_hu: Gallup-felmérés: az amerikaiak többsége csak orvosi felügyelet mellett bízná a diagnózist az AI-ra
prioritas.lead_hu: Egy új Gallup-kutatás szerint a betegek 56 százaléka elfogadja az AI által hozott orvosi döntéseket, ha azokat az orvos felülbírálhatja. Mindössze 9 százalék bízna meg teljesen az önálló mesterséges intelligenciában.
